chunks: Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadala and Hammad ibn Isa from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the most virtuous time for the Witr prayer, so he said, 'Fajr is the beginning of that.'

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the best time to pray Witr according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies the early hours of Fajr as the most virtuous time for Witr, distinguishing it from the later night hours often preferred for voluntary prayers. This ruling highlights the unique status of the dawn period in Shia jurisprudence, where the transition from night to day offers a distinct spiritual opportunity for concluding one's night worship. The emphasis on 'first of that' suggests a preference for performing Witr immediately upon the onset of Fajr time rather than delaying it.
